On tuple containing n_j copies of idempotent e_j, mixed-label cycles vanish and contributing permutations are ∏ S_nj, so f_m=∏_j (c_j)_nj. Mod p, (c_j)_s≠0 precisely when 0≤s≤the canonical lift a_j∈{0,...,p−1}. Existence of multiplicity vectors of sum m is equivalent to m≤∑a_j, and multilinearity extends this to the entire A^m. Hence minimal normalization-free degree w and distribution [t^d](1+...+t^(p−1))^r, including zero map, p=2 and r=1. Independent exhaustive bounded combinatorics for p=2,3,5, r≤3, m≤6 agreed; infinite assertion follows from the integral signed-cycle identity, not enumeration.
